surface_label: Accenture Plc becomes the controlling person (75%+ shares and votes) of Faculty Science Ltd, 12 March 2026
bounded_by: Companies House PSC register, filing history and officers list for 08873131 as archived
notes: PSC02: Accenture Plc (Ireland, IE471706) notified 12 March 2026 with ownership of shares 75% or more, voting rights 75% or more and the right to appoint or remove directors. PSC07: Applied Acquisition Co. Limited (Guernsey, 69131; PSC since 21 May 2021 at more than 25% but not more than 50%) ceased the same day. Same day: SH01 allotment (nominal capital GBP 5.276292), directors Saul Charles Klein and Mark John Selwyn Beith terminated, two Accenture-side directors appointed. The register does not state the price. DSIT declared on 10 October 2024 that Matt Clifford held shares directly in Faculty Science; this register does not show whether or how his holding was sold.
